findings.evidenceJa: 壮絶な剣戟
findings.governingReading: the ferocious clash of swords
findings.explanation: The immediate sound and weapon form of the fighting are generalized.

findings.highlight: the stairwell down to the hall
findings.evidenceJa: 広間の吹き抜け
findings.governingReading: the atrium opening over the hall
findings.explanation: The architectural route is changed from an open atrium to a stairwell.

findings.highlight: We don’t stand a chance either way
findings.evidenceJa: 二人でいようと一人でいようと同じだ
findings.governingReading: that is the same whether we are together or alone
findings.explanation: Equal escape risk is rewritten as lack of combat chance.

findings.highlight: There’s no point in staying together right now
findings.evidenceJa: だから分かれる
findings.governingReading: that is why we split up
findings.explanation: The English inserts a dismissive rationale instead of the source’s survival calculation.

findings.evidenceJa: 懇願に近い響き
findings.governingReading: a sound closer to pleading
findings.explanation: Rin’s suppressed plea for Shirou to survive is weakened to a wish.

findings.evidenceJa: 大回りをして
findings.governingReading: I take the long way around
findings.explanation: The extent of Shirou’s detour disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺と同じタイミングで到着した遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka arrives at the same moment I do
findings.explanation: The synchronized arrival proving the route geometry is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 声を押し殺していた
findings.governingReading: we both suppress our voices
findings.explanation: Their deliberate stealth response becomes an involuntary audible reaction.

findings.highlight: his dreadful roar is louder now
findings.evidenceJa: 鬼気迫る咆哮は以前の比ではない
findings.governingReading: the harrowing ferocity of his roar is beyond comparison with before
findings.explanation: Qualitative murderous intensity becomes volume.

findings.highlight: shivering and watching her Servant with a face almost in tears
findings.evidenceJa: 肩を震わせ、泣き叫ぶ一歩手前の顔
findings.governingReading: shoulders trembling, watching her Servant with a face one step from screaming and crying
findings.explanation: Illya’s near-breakdown is reduced to generic shivering and tears.

findings.evidenceJa: 無数の剣が舞う
findings.governingReading: countless swords dance
findings.explanation: The signature visual motion is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: 貫く
findings.governingReading: They pierce
findings.explanation: The exact bodily action disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 湯水の如く
findings.governingReading: as freely and inexhaustibly as water
findings.explanation: The idiom for prodigal abundance becomes a physical water-motion simile.

findings.highlight: Pieces are blown from his body
findings.evidenceJa: 吹き飛ぶ五体
findings.governingReading: his whole body is blown apart
findings.explanation: The complete bodily impact becomes unspecified pieces.

findings.highlight: regenerates every time he is killed
findings.evidenceJa: 即死する度に蘇り
findings.governingReading: revives each time he dies instantly
findings.explanation: God Hand’s discrete resurrection is mislabeled as regeneration.

findings.evidenceJa: 楽しげに笑って迎えた
findings.governingReading: greets him laughing with pleasure
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s enjoyment of Berserker’s deaths disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 死んでもその場で蘇生する
findings.governingReading: the ability to revive on the spot after death
findings.explanation: The timing and location of God Hand’s resurrection disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 秩序を持たない、ただ殺す事が目的の戦い
findings.governingReading: a battle without order whose only purpose is killing
findings.explanation: The absence of any governing order in Gilgamesh’s desired violence disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 敵を屠り殺すだけ
findings.governingReading: advances solely to slaughter his enemy
findings.explanation: Berserker’s offensive purpose disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: あえて歩を止め
findings.governingReading: he deliberately halts his advance
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s tactical choice is reduced to posture.

findings.evidenceJa: 愚鈍なまでに歩を進める
findings.governingReading: advances with a persistence bordering on dull-wittedness
findings.explanation: The narrator’s judgment of Berserker’s apparent stupidity disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=バーサーカー char=4]暗愚の輩
findings.governingReading: a benighted fool—a Berserker
findings.explanation: A conditional English branch inserts extreme profanity unsupported by the insult or ruby.

findings.evidenceJa: 戦うだけのモノであったか
findings.governingReading: so you were merely a thing made to fight
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s dehumanizing judgment of Berserker’s nature becomes an ability limitation.

findings.highlight: The Noble Phantasms emerge from space
findings.evidenceJa: 宝具が[ruby text=はし]奔る
findings.governingReading: the Noble Phantasms race forth
findings.explanation: Fast launched motion becomes appearance.

findings.evidenceJa: 宝具に指令を下した
findings.governingReading: he issues a command to the Noble Phantasms
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s authority over the weapons becomes preparation.

findings.highlight: It will be unpleasant for you to come any closer
findings.evidenceJa: これ以上近づかれては暑苦しい
findings.governingReading: having you come any closer would be stifling to me
findings.explanation: The discomfort is assigned to Berserker rather than Gilgamesh.

findings.evidenceJa: 大部分にその命を奪われた
findings.governingReading: most of them take his life
findings.explanation: The distribution across incoming weapons becomes a divisible quantity of life.

findings.evidenceJa: 体は、既に死に体だ
findings.governingReading: his body is already effectively dead
findings.explanation: A completed bodily state is weakened to an ongoing process.

findings.highlight: a mere target survived my attack
findings.evidenceJa: いまだ形を留めるか
findings.governingReading: a mere large target still retains its shape
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s surprise at bodily integrity becomes survival.

findings.highlight: with his body slashed and with his limbs pierced
findings.evidenceJa: 肉を削がれ、足を穿たれ
findings.governingReading: with flesh shorn away and legs gouged through
findings.explanation: The injuries’ exact tissues and body parts are generalized.

findings.highlight: to protect the frightened Master behind him
findings.evidenceJa: 怯える少女を宝具の雨から守る為に
findings.governingReading: to protect the frightened girl behind him from the rain of Noble Phantasms
findings.explanation: The attack Berserker draws away from Illya disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 生き残るという戦い
findings.governingReading: a battle in which the first to achieve his aim survives
findings.explanation: The fight’s literal life-or-death outcome is generalized to victory.

findings.highlight: It is a battle with no hope of victory
findings.evidenceJa: 勝ち目のない戦いだったとしても
findings.governingReading: even if it had been a battle with no chance from the start
findings.explanation: A concessive possibility is promoted into asserted fact.

findings.highlight: Coming out of his tenth death
findings.evidenceJa: 十度目の死を越え
findings.governingReading: surpassing his tenth death
findings.explanation: Berserker’s cumulative transcendence is weakened to emergence.

findings.highlight: weapon that has not yet been raised against the man
findings.evidenceJa: 一度たりとも男に対して振るわれなかった剛剣
findings.governingReading: mighty sword that had not once been swung at the man
findings.explanation: The culmination of finally executing an attack becomes mere weapon posture.

findings.highlight: trying to tear off the rock-like head
findings.evidenceJa: 岩のような首でさえ、その張力で絞り切ろうとしていた
findings.governingReading: the tension tries to strangle through even his rock-like neck
findings.explanation: The chain’s constriction and target body part are changed.

findings.evidenceJa: 強制撤去を命じる
findings.governingReading: orders Berserker’s forced withdrawal
findings.explanation: The Command Spell’s supernatural removal order is reduced to ordinary retreat.

findings.evidenceJa: 令呪による空間転移
findings.governingReading: spatial transference by Command Spell
findings.explanation: The specific teleportation mechanism is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 今度こそ、本当に終わった
findings.governingReading: this time, it was truly over
findings.explanation: The decisive completed beat is shifted into present tense.

findings.evidenceJa: 奇怪なオブジェにしかとれない形
findings.governingReading: in a form that could only be taken for a grotesque object
findings.explanation: A perceptual simile becomes literal transformation.

findings.highlight: check if he’s alive or not
findings.evidenceJa: 息があるかなど見るまでもない
findings.governingReading: no need even to check whether he is breathing
findings.explanation: The concrete sign of life changes.

findings.highlight: Even if he may have been stronger
findings.evidenceJa: 英雄としての精度で上回ろうと
findings.governingReading: however much one surpasses him in precision as a hero
findings.explanation: The metaphysical quality being compared is reduced to strength.

findings.evidenceJa: 墓標となった黒い巨体
findings.governingReading: the black giant body that had become a grave marker
findings.explanation: The death-image linking body and memorial disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 少女の光を奪いさった
findings.governingReading: stole the girl’s light away
findings.explanation: A conditional English branch makes the implied loss of sight an explicit eye-slashing action.

findings.highlight: He impales the giant with a lance
findings.evidenceJa: 槍で巨人を仕留める
findings.governingReading: he finishes the giant with a lance
findings.explanation: The killing completion of the Gae Bolg-like strike is weakened to impalement.
